# Teacher Training Dashboard agents

Repository-specific agent profiles for this project. Select the lead agent for end-to-end feature work; it can route focused work to specialists when the environment supports delegation. Specialists can also be selected directly.

| Agent profile | Role |
| --- | --- |
| teacher-training-dashboard.agent.md | Leads and coordinates dashboard changes across the training lifecycle. |
| product-manager.agent.md | Clarifies user needs, scope, requirements, and acceptance criteria. |
| scrum-master.agent.md | Breaks approved work into ordered tasks and identifies dependencies. |
| react-developer.agent.md | Handles frontend work when React is present. |
| node-developer.agent.md | Handles service work when Node.js is present. |
| csharp-developer.agent.md | Handles .NET/C# work when those technologies are present. |
| db-query-optimizer.agent.md | Reviews data access and query efficiency. |
| tester-developer.agent.md | Designs and implements focused automated tests. |
| code-reviewer.agent.md | Performs read-only code review. |
| security-reviewer.agent.md | Performs read-only security review. |
| devops-azure.agent.md | Handles Azure work when it is present and requested. |

These profiles do not establish the application's framework, database, hosting provider, or certification rules. Agents must inspect the repository and use project- or user-defined requirements.
